# `<sl-option>` — Option

Options define the selectable items within various form controls such as [select](select.md).

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/option/option.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | — | `string` | `''` | The option's value. When selected, the containing form control will receive this value. The value must be unique from other options in the same group. Values may not contain spaces, as spaces are used as delimiters when listing multiple values. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the option in a disabled state, preventing selection. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `getTextLabel()` | Returns a plain text label based on the option's content. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The option's label. |
| `prefix` | Used to prepend an icon or similar element to the menu item. |
| `suffix` | Used to append an icon or similar element to the menu item. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `checked-icon` | The checked icon, an `<sl-icon>` element. |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `label` | The option's label. |
| `prefix` | The container that wraps the prefix. |
| `suffix` | The container that wraps the suffix. |

## Documentation and examples

```html
<sl-select label="Select one">
  <sl-option value="option-1">Option 1</sl-option>
  <sl-option value="option-2">Option 2</sl-option>
  <sl-option value="option-3">Option 3</sl-option>
</sl-select>
```

## Examples

### Disabled

Use the `disabled` attribute to disable an option and prevent it from being selected.

```html
<sl-select label="Select one">
  <sl-option value="option-1">Option 1</sl-option>
  <sl-option value="option-2" disabled>Option 2</sl-option>
  <sl-option value="option-3">Option 3</sl-option>
</sl-select>
```

### Prefix & Suffix

Add icons to the start and end of menu items using the `prefix` and `suffix` slots.

```html
<sl-select label="Select one">
  <sl-option value="option-1">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="envelope"></sl-icon>
    Email
    <sl-icon slot="suffix" name="patch-check"></sl-icon>
  </sl-option>

  <sl-option value="option-2">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="telephone"></sl-icon>
    Phone
    <sl-icon slot="suffix" name="patch-check"></sl-icon>
  </sl-option>

  <sl-option value="option-3">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="chat-dots"></sl-icon>
    Chat
    <sl-icon slot="suffix" name="patch-check"></sl-icon>
  </sl-option>
</sl-select>
```
